created_prompt: I am looking to create a 3 year plan. My primary goals are my online growth and creating and publishing a cookbook. Currently I stand at 1.2 million followers, and want to expand my range and capitalize on the following I have developed so far. I need ideas on how to maximize my time and budget, currently working 4 days weekly, as such my time and budget are limited. My current content is mainly focused on quick, healthy recipes for creation at home. My cookbook will be something similar.
